bio.text: Joshua Bryant of Rogers was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 32 in Benton and Washington counties.
He served one term in the Arkansas House, from 2021 through 2022.

After graduating from BCCS in Rogers in 1996, he served five years in the U.S. Marine Corps, reaching the rank of sergeant, then worked 12 years for the Federal Aviation Administration before joining a construction venture in 2014.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JOSHUA BRYANT
